newsitem.title: FRANCE: Guns found, 13 Islamists held in France.
newsitem.headline: Guns found, 13 Islamists held in France.

text.p: French police found several assault rifles and detained 13 suspected members of a Moslem fundamentalist group in the Paris region on Tuesday, investigators said.
The guns were found in a search of the headquarters of the group, known as the "Muslim Association", in the western suburb of La Garenne Colombes, they said.
The swoop began after members of the group were found in a routine weekend road check to be carrying Islamic propaganda including anti-Semitic documents.
Those being held in police custody were French nationals of Algerian and Tunisian descent. They would be brought before a magistrate by the end of the week.
French police have stepped up security measures under the so-called Vigipirate plan imposed after a spate of bombings in 1995 killed eight people.
The plan was revived after a bomb attack last December on a commuter train in Paris killed four people.
The bombings have been blamed on Moslem fundamentalist rebels fighting to overthrow the Algerian government.
